messages.subject: theme_set question
parts:
I am producing several graphs in a script and keep running into the
same issue while trying to remove the standard background of ggplot.

For each unique graph...I plot them in the standard manner and add "+
theme_set(theme_bw())" to the list of arguments.

Eg. p1 = ggplot(...) + geom_point(...) + geom_line(...) +
theme_set(theme_bw())

The problem I have is that when I run the script as a whole...the
script crawls through each graphical output and it seems that it
sometimes ignores the theme_bw instruction.

I end up with graphs that do and don't have the gray background. When
plotting the graphs one-by-one I do get the desired effects...however
when trying to automate the entire script I get differing results.

Is there a better way to do this? Does the theme_set() argument revert
to defaults? Thanks in advance for any advice!

--
